statement: A deterministic derived artifact must be produced by its authoritative generator even for an empty-data bootstrap state; a hand-written object that is semantically similar but has a different deterministic shape must not be treated as equivalent generated state.

scope.notes: The concrete evidence is the production visual-evidence index; the Claim is limited to deterministic derived artifacts with an authoritative generator.

assumptions.statement: The artifact has a deterministic authoritative generator whose output shape is part of repository validation.

review.rationale: Migrated from a validated failure/recovery pair for deterministic visual-evidence derived state.
